section: Removal of prior version deprecations and changes
summary: Series.append and DataFrame.append were removed in pandas 2.0; use pandas.concat instead.
pandas.concat has ignore_index=False by default. Setting it to True discards labels on the concatenation axis; False preserves them.

section: Removal of prior version deprecations and changes
summary: Series.iteritems and DataFrame.iteritems were removed; use obj.items instead.
